title: The cone identity in terms of test forms (parent step 2)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) a cone current (IsConeCurrent C: for every λ > 0 and every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), currentEval (blowUp C 0 λ) ω = C(ω), where blowUp C 0 λ = η_{0,λ#}C is the proper affine push-forward of C by η(y) = −λ^{-1}·0 + λ^{-1}y). Then for every λ > 0 and every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P) there is a test form ω' ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = λ^{-n}·ω(λ^{-1}y) for every y ∈ ℝ^P and C(ω') = C(ω).
